note: Risk-only scope. Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List listing found for Ammann India Pvt Ltd or Ammann Apollo India Pvt Ltd; parent Ammann Group is a Swiss family-owned construction-equipment maker (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ammann_Group) and no listing of the group was surfaced. Court exposure is civil/tax in nature: a series of Gujarat HC writ petitions against the Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax (2025-02-04, 2026-03-12, 2026-06-09) and a long-running 'Apollo' trademark/name dispute running from Gujarat HC C/SCA/4303/2021 up to Supreme Court daily orders as recently as 2026-08-20; the company appears as petitioner in all of these, plus one 2022 Special Criminal Application (quashing-type writ) where it is also petitioner. Per project rules these are noted neutrally and are not rejection grounds. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings action for this entity could be retrieved (CRISIL search endpoint returned a 404 error page), so no rating is asserted. Revenue/export volumes and legal identity deliberately not researched per role scope.
